cases.prompt: Using the supplied presentation-box photograph as the product reference, photograph this same closed ivory rigid box with separate fitted lid, identical proportions, seams and matte paper texture. Three-quarter view with the lid top and two sides visible, pale lilac studio sweep and soft broad daylight, complete box in frame. Keep every printable surface plain ivory, blank and unprinted. No artwork, lettering, labels, ribbon or additional objects. This plain-surface photograph will receive supplied brand artwork in a separate compositing step.

Using the supplied takeaway-cup photograph as the reference, retain the same plain ivory tapered paper cup, dark charcoal lid and adult hand holding it below and beside the printable front. Preserve the shape, lid rim, realistic paper texture and natural hand anatomy. Soft daylight, warm taupe background, entire cup visible and sharply focused. Cup body plain ivory and unprinted, no logo or text. Leave the front clear for a separate artwork-compositing step.

Edit this supplied photograph. Preserve the same adult man, face, hair, pose, white studio, lighting, camera crop, plain white cotton T-shirt, collar, shoulder seams, sleeves, hem and trousers. Remove only the patch pocket from the T-shirt: make the chest a continuous plain white cotton panel with natural gentle folds and no pocket outline or pocket stitching. This is intentionally a pocketless demonstration variant for applying a large front graphic in a separate compositor. Do not add any artwork, text or print. Keep the chest broad and visible.

Turn this original room blockout drawing into an editorial-quality photorealistic ecommerce bed-linen photograph. Use the supplied composition reference, not any existing bedroom photograph. Preserve the distinct low oak bed and wide vertically fluted oak headboard, full bed visible at a foot-left three-quarter angle, tall recessed window on the LEFT wall, one wide pillow leaning against the headboard and muted olive cube bedside table on the RIGHT. The pillow must rest on the mattress, not float. Refine the crude drawn geometry into physically plausible furniture. Quiet adult bedroom, soft off-white plaster walls, pale oak floor, broad soft daylight from the left, calm warm neutral palette. Plain unprinted ivory washed cotton-linen duvet cover with visible fine weave, natural broad gentle folds and a slightly turned-back top edge, a separate plain ivory pillowcase and plain fitted sheet visible between them. Duvet drapes over the foot and right side, clear uncluttered bedding surfaces suitable for a later supplied print. Keep all textile surfaces entirely plain and unprinted. High-end natural interior photography, accurate perspective, subtle shadow detail, full bed in frame, fabric sharply resolved. No wall art, bunting, toys, baskets, decorative cushions, logos, patterns, text or people. The drawing is only a layout and palette reference; the result must look like a real photograph, not a sketch or polygonal render.

Use the supplied newly generated room photograph ONLY as a daylight, wall finish and oak-floor reference. Make a different original product scene for a cotton throw: remove the bed, pillow, headboard and bedside block entirely. In their place show a realistically proportioned adult lounge armchair in warm caramel leather with low solid walnut legs, a clearly visible seat cushion, backrest and two curved upholstered arms. The chair is comfortably sized for one adult, approximately 80 cm wide, 85 cm deep, seat height 43 cm, back height 85 cm. Camera at seated eye level, front three-quarter view, full chair and floor around its legs in frame, with the tall window at the left. Drape a lightweight solid ivory woven cotton throw naturally over the chair's left back corner and arm, across part of the seat, with one broad section falling over the front of the seat toward the floor. Show the throw's fine cotton weave, soft natural folds and short tassel fringe on the lower hanging edge. It is a throw used on a chair, not a table runner: no table, dining chair, bench, bed or tablecloth. Keep enough caramel leather exposed to distinguish cloth from upholstery. Keep the textile entirely plain ivory, no printed pattern, logos, stripes, lettering or decorative props. Natural material-rich ecommerce interior photography, soft window daylight, quiet off-white plaster, subtle realistic shadows. Composition and furniture dimensions must be physically plausible.
